set.body: Outcome: demonstrate stage parity against pinned MATLAB source through Octave and runnable Python paths, with explicit bug/method differences; improve profiled representative R workflows. Scope: synthetic fixtures, geometry/histograms/branch/AOF/MAT stage matrix, R/C++ hotspots, regressions and local benchmark/check receipts. Preserve upstream snapshots and canonical data. Acceptance: executable comparison harness, independent invariants, measured before/after speedups without loss of correctness, full bounded R check and coverage. No actual MATLAB equivalence claim without a MATLAB runtime; no external publication. Next: profile feature extraction, junction-rich drawings and full MAT analysis; execute diverse differential fixtures.
set.title: Extend parity evidence and optimize representative MLV workloads
